trial.interpretation: The tail-loss classifier carried meaningful discrimination, but the full prelocked opportunity-quality stack selected zero development trades and the good-opportunity classifier was near chance. IFE2 therefore did not establish executable positive edge.

contaminationBoundary.prohibitedRescue: No IFE2 feature/model/score/hard-gate/quantile may be tuned or promoted using these outcomes.

terminalRule: No further transformation of the same OHLC/context feature family is authorized. Any continuation must add genuinely new market information such as derivatives microstructure, funding, order-flow, order-book or event data under a separately named program with fresh locks.
